qAndA.answer: TJ chooses the 64-bit version because he knows his computer can handle it. He advises viewers to choose the 32-bit version if they aren't sure which one to download.

qAndA.answer: TJ locates the downloaded installer file in his "Downloads" folder which is accessible through his file system window.

qAndA.answer: He either clicks on the Start menu icon or presses the Windows key on his keyboard.

qAndA.answer: A working directory is used to store all of the user's projects and related files for easy organization and access within the program.
qAndA.question: What is the purpose of creating a working directory in LMMS?
